title: Stats, invoice total and tax add up the saved line prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Make sure your location's parts tax rate is known (for example 5% GST).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Click Add Part under line 1.
  9. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  10. Type 1 in Qty.
  11. Pick category A in Category.
  12. Type 50.00 in Cost.
  13. Click Save.
  14. Click the Stats tab.
  15. Click Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The first part reads $120.00 ($100.00 × 1.20).

Step 8:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 9:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 10:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 11:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 12:

  • Cost holds 50.00 as typed.

Step 13:

  • The second part reads $60.00 ($50.00 × 1.20).

Step 14:

  • Stats show parts of $180.00 ($120.00 + $60.00 = $180.00) beside the line's labor.

Step 15:

  • The invoice's parts total reads $180.00.
  • Its tax on parts reads $180.00 × the tax rate (for example 5% = $9.00).
